Greetings, Adventurers! 😉

Don't miss out on our Monthly Attendance Event!
Log in on the 25th of every month to receive your free rewards!

Check the schedule and join the event! 🔥

notes.title: [Event] Synergy Farewell Event 🎆
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34040677/de9c8a31da940b9c33316b1e7ad75b32db2d4ebe.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Greetings, Adventurers! 🌌 
[/p][p]As the current season comes to a close, we’re excited to announce our October End-of-Season Event.  This is your chance to make the most of the final weeks, earn valuable rewards, and prepare for the next chapter! 🌟[/p][p] [/p][h1]1. Farewell to Synergy [/h1][p][/p][p][b]Event Period[/b]
- Sep 23rd, 2025 (Tue) after maintenance - Oct 28th, 2025 (Tue) before maintenance

[b]Event Details[/b] [/p][p]- \[Season Server Only] Gather Synergy Coins to unlock quests and claim event items and EXP.[/p][table colwidth="121,212,210,"][tr][th colwidth="121"][p]NPC[/p][/th][th colwidth="212"][p]Quest Name[/p][/th][th colwidth="210"][p]Required Item[/p][/th][th][p]Reward[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td colwidth="121"][p]Archeologist Lafam[/p][/td][td colwidth="212"][p]\[Daily] Season3 Synergy Cake[/p][/td][td colwidth="210"][p]Synergy coin 10ea[/p][/td][td][p]Synergy Celebrate Cake (EXP +130% for 30min)[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="121"][p]Archeologist Lafam[/p][/td][td colwidth="212"][p]\[Series] Reliving the Memories[/p][/td][td colwidth="210"][p]Synergy coin 10ea[/p][/td][td][p]13,000,000 EXP[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="121"][p]Archeologist Lafam[/p][/td][td colwidth="212"][p]\[Series] Moments of Glory[/p][/td][td colwidth="210"][p]Synergy coin 100ea[/p][/td][td][p]130,000,000 EXP[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="121"][p]Archeologist Lafam[/p][/td][td colwidth="212"][p]\[Series] Farewell to Synergy![/p][/td][td colwidth="210"][p]Synergy coin 1000ea[/p][/td][td][p]1,300,000,000 EXP[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]    *NPC Archeologist Lafam is located in Redisse City.
[/p][p]- \[Season& Standard Server] Visit Event NPC Landiboy to create your Synergy Celebrate Cake.[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth="102,144,"][tr][th colwidth="102"][p]NPC[/p][/th][th colwidth="144"][p]Required Item[/p][/th][th][p]Item[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td colwidth="102"][p]Landiboy[/p][/td][td colwidth="144"][p]Synergy coin 10ea[/p][/td][td][p]Synergy Celebrate Cake (EXP +130% for 30min)[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p]- \[Season& Standard Server] Synergy Coins have a chance to drop from hunting and can also be purchased from Premium Merchants for 10 Premium Points each.[/p][table colwidth=""][tr][th][p]Synergy Coin Drop Region[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p]Nadkath Island, Nadkath Lava Dungeon[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]
※ Notice
- Event quests from NPC Archeologist Lafam are available only on the Season Server. [/p][p]- The Series quest is accessible only a single time. [/p][p]- The ‘Synergy Coin’ and 'Synergy Celebrate Cake' will be deleted on scheduled maintenance on October 28th, UTC.   [/p][p]
[/p][h1]2. Lazio Entrance Ticket 50% Off Event[/h1][p][/p][p][b]Event Period[/b]
- Sep 23rd, 2025 (Tue) after maintenance - Oct 28th, 2025 (Tue) before maintenance

[b]Event Details[/b] [/p][p]- The Lazio Entrance Ticket Discount Event has begun! In general, a Lazio Entrance Ticket costs 1,000,000 Florins, but during the event, it can be purchased at a 50% discount for 500,000 Florins. [/p][p][/p][table colwidth="215,"][tr][th colwidth="215"][p]Item Name[/p][/th][th][p]Price (50% OFF)[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td colwidth="215"][p]Eos Sealed Private Flying Ship Ticket (24 Hours)[/p][/td][td][p]500,000 Florin[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p] [/p][p]※ Notice  [/p][p]- The event item ‘Lazio Entrance Ticket’ is only available during the event period. [/p][p]- The ‘Lazio Entrance Ticket’ will be deleted after scheduled maintenance on October 28th, UTC. [/p][p]- The “Go into Battle for Lazio” achievement quest cannot be completed using the event item.  [/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]3. Transformation Card Sale Event [/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34040677/403700fed5cbbd8870e8c91f3fe3776564d9c8e8.jpg"][/img][b]Event Period[/b]
- Sep 23rd, 2025 (Tue) after maintenance - Oct 14th, 2025 (Tue) before maintenance

[b]Event Details[/b]
- During the event period, we'll be selling guaranteed cards for Neria and Neria of Fog.
Additionally, there will be transformation event bonuses (Neria: EXP +5%, Neria of Fog: EXP +15%) throughout the event duration.

※ Notice
▶ This item is scheduled to be discontinued after the maintenance on October 14th, 2025.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34040677/09e143a41cdf6147be5ab46b987fa344723affeb.png"][/img][b]Event Period[/b]
- Oct 14th, 2025 (Tue) after maintenance - Oct 28th, 2025 (Tue) before maintenance

[b]Event Details[/b]
- During the event period, we'll be selling guaranteed cards for Floria and Floria of Ambition.
Additionally, there will be transformation event bonuses (Floria: EXP +5%, Floria of Ambition: EXP +15%) throughout the event duration.

※ Notice
▶ This item is scheduled to be discontinued after the maintenance on October 28th, 2025.\[/p][/p]

notes.title: [Event] September Harvest & Hunt Event 🍂
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34040677/1b807b8a9f5c654dbef0c24e747341b402c9c438.jpg"][/img]
Hello Adventurers!🍁
The autumn breeze has arrived, and so has our special Fall Event!
Join us and enjoy exciting rewards and seasonal fun prepared just for you.

[/p][h1]1. Monster Hunting Contest [/h1][p]
[b]Event Period[/b]
- Aug 26, 2025 (Tue) after maintenance - Sep 23, 2025 (Tue) before maintenance

[b]Event Details[/b]
- Let's enjoy Monster Hunting Contest through the Time Dungeon teleport Gem in Twilight Hill!
The Hunting Contest is available for 1 hour per day, and entry is possible for levels 40 and above.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34040677/9e55f4831874c15b3001e6539d314513534d7fbc.png"][/img]
Hunt monsters and get [b]Tokens of Slayer[/b] in the Monster Hunting Contest!
The tokens of Slayer are automatically acquired in your inventory when hunting monsters.
Tokens of Slayer items can be obtained from the following monsters.

[/p][table colwidth=""][tr][th][p]Hunting Contest Monsters List[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p]Violent Crab, Violent Buffalo, Violent Wolf, Violent Beast, Violent Hound, 
Gnoll, Gnoll Archer, Gnoll Warrior, Gnoll Elder, Gnoll Great Warrior, 
Werewolf, Werewolf Warrior, Werewolf Berserker, 
Eagler, Eagler Archer, Eagler Warrior, Eagler Elder, 
Lizardman, Lizardman Warrior, Lizardman Axeman, Lizardman High Priest, 
Lionman Archer, Lionman Warrior, Lionman Shaman[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34040677/0e974456b202e9303875aa2bd41fa28e2b425442.png"][/img]
Take the Tokens of Slayer to the NPC Landiboy in the metropolis!
You can craft various items using Tokens of Slayer.

[/p][table colwidth=","][tr][th][p]Crafting Materials[/p][/th][th][p]Item Name[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p]Token of Slayer 50ea[/p][/td][td][p]Human Attack Scroll[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Token of Slayer 50ea[/p][/td][td][p]Elemental Attack Scroll[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Token of Slayer 50ea[/p][/td][td][p]Demon Attack Scroll[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Token of Slayer 50ea[/p][/td][td][p]Undead Attack Scroll[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Token of Slayer 50ea[/p][/td][td][p]Beast Attack Scroll[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Token of Slayer 100ea[/p][/td][td][p]EXP Growth Potion 100% [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Token of Slayer 150ea[/p][/td][td][p][b]Hunting Contest Reward Box[/b][/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]
[/p][table colwidth=""][tr][th][p]Hunting Contest Reward Box Item List[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p]* Can be obtained one of the following items
Holy Water
Dark Stone 
Faded Ancient Book of Combat
Faded Legacy of Ancient Magic
Soul Sealing Stone of Sabnok
Soul Sealing Stone of Infuriated Shuriel
Soul Sealing Stone of Infuriated Euriel
Soul Sealing Stone of Phoenix
Recovery Holy Book (100%)
Essence of Chaos
Powder of Chaos
Crystal Bag
Blue Ancient Scroll : Grace
Red Ancient Scroll : Grace
Black Ancient Scroll : Grace
Essence of Salvation
Eos Dragon Knights’ Buff Potion
Eos Dragon's Blessing
Dark Stone Piece
Blessed Transformation Scroll [/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]
※ Notice
- The token of Slayer, Hunting Contest Reward Box, All attack scrolls (Human, Demon, Undead, Elemental, Beast) will be deleted after scheduled maintenance on Sep 23, 2025 UTC.
- The Monster Hunting Contest is a free PvP zone, so EXP and Inclination points do not decrease. (However, if you die from a monster, your EXP will decrease.)
- Blessing of the Goddess, Blessed Grace of Dione, and Grace of Dione are not applied within the Monster Hunting Contest area.
- The entry time for the Monster Hunting Contest is reset every day at 6:00 AM (UTC).
- This content is subject to change without prior notice.

[/p][h1]2. Autumn Harvest Event[/h1][p]
[b]Event Period[/b]
- Aug 26, 2025 (Tue) after maintenance - Sep 23, 2025 (Tue) before maintenance

[b]Event Details[/b]
- During the event period, you can obtain an item called 'Delicious Apple' by defeating monsters in certain regions. If you give Delicious Apples as a gift to NPC Landiboy, you can craft a special buff item. 

[/p][table colwidth=",,,"][tr][th][p]Required Material[/p][/th][th][p]Item Name[/p][/th][th][p]Effect[/p][/th][th][p]Duration[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p]Delicious Apple 100ea[/p][/td][td][p]Autumn Blessing Scroll[/p][/td][td][p]All Attacks (Melee, Ranged, SP)+5

[/p][h1]3. Radiant Enchantment Event [/h1][p]
[b]Event Period[/b]
- Aug 26, 2025 (Tue) after maintenance - Sep 23, 2025 (Tue) before maintenance

▶ Can participate all server members

[/p][h1]4. Transformation Card Sale Event [/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34040677/bf74db12483afb3175d917bc12454d4c321feb62.jpg"][/img][b]Event Period[/b]

notes.title: [Event] Nadkath's Awakening 🌋
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34040677/9fe66ee07d6cc4b943061b681a1781bb2462174c.jpg[/img]

Hello Adventurers! 

Happy June! May this month bring you more time, more quests, more EXP, and more power!
create unforgettable memories. Cheers to a fabulous month! 🙌

[h1]1. Nadkath Event[/h1]

[b]Event Period[/b]
- May 27, 2025 (Tue) after maintenance - June 24, 2025 (Tue) before maintenance

Event Details
- During the event period, Nadkath's available time will be extended from 3 hours to 4 hours.
Take advantage of the extra time to achieve more and acquire items in Nadkath.

[table]
    [tr]
        [th]Dungeon[/th]
        [th]Hours[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Nadkath[/td]
        [td]3 hours + 1 hour[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]


[h1]2. Trace of a Soulbound shard[/h1]

[b]Event Period[/b]
- May 27, 2025 (Tue) after maintenance - June 24, 2025 (Tue) before maintenance

[b]Event Details[/b]
- During the event, you can participate in the quest ‘Trace of a Soulbound Shard.’
- This quest is available for players level 49 and above, and can be accepted from NPC Golden Nox in Redisse City.
- The Nadkath Soul Shard can be obtained by defeating Nadkath monsters or purchased for 3,000 Florin each from the Nadkath merchant NPC Skard, and any town merchant NPC.

        [th]Level[/th]
        [th]Quest Name[/th]
        [th]Reward[/th]

        [td]EXP 40,000,000
10% EXP based on Lv. 49[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Lv. 55–59[/td]
        [td][Daily] Trace of a Soulbound Shard 2[/td]
        [td]EXP 80,000,000
10% EXP based on Lv. 55[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Lv. 60–64[/td]
        [td][Daily] Trace of a Soulbound Shard 3[/td]
        [td]EXP 120,000,000
10% EXP based on Lv. 60[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]
※ Notice
▶ Nadkath Soul Shard has a chance to drop when defeating Nadkath monsters in the Nadkath region. Alternatively, it can be purchased from the Nadkath merchant NPC Skard and any town merchant NPC for 3,000 Florin each.

[h1]3. New Transformation Card Sale Event[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34040677/4cd62f15b99908fa9ab0d2a7108f2273b96851b8.jpg[/img]
[b]Event Period[/b]
- May 27, 2025 (Tue) after maintenance - June 10, 2025 (Tue) before maintenance

- During the event, we'll sell guaranteed cards for Felix and Golden Felix.
Additionally, there will be transformation event bonuses (Felix: EXP +5%, Golden Felix.: EXP +15%) throughout the event duration.

※ Notice
▶ This item is scheduled to be discontinued after the maintenance on June 10, 2025.

notes.title: ⚔Enter the Colosseum – A Battle for Glory⚔ (Modified)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34040677/62092bf6db1710b217330b872c3f2aeca653d163.jpg[/img]
Hello, warriors!

Are you ready to prove your strength on the ultimate battlefield?
The [b]Colosseum[/b] is an intense PvP and PvE arena where only the strongest survive. 
For [b]one month only,[/b] warriors can enter the Colosseum and battle fierce opponents from their own server. Don't miss your chance to dominate the arena!

[b] Colosseum Schedule[/b] 
📅 Duration:  March 11 - April 8
🗡 Opens:  Every Monday & Friday at 21:20 UTC

[b]How to Join:[/b]
[list]
[*] Entry NPC: Leina in Laden City
[*] Registration Time: 21:00 – 21:19, UTC (Mon&Fri)
[*] Level Requirement: 51+
[*] Entry Fee: 3,000 Florin (non-refundable)
[/list]

[b] Colosseum Highlights [/b]
🚫[b] Restricted Items & Skills[/b] – Certain transformation sticks/scrolls, invisibility cloaks, summoning items, and teleportation skills are disabled.
🐉[b] Monster Domination Mode[/b] – Powerful monsters appear mid-battle, adding an unpredictable challenge. Defeating key bosses grants valuable rewards.
🏆 [b]Victory Condition[/b] – The battle ends when the final boss, Red Dragon, is slain. The winning team earns extra Colosseum Gold!

Want to learn more? Check out the [url=http://dk-wiki.masanggames.com/dkwiki/index.php/Colosseum]Colosseum Wiki Page[/url] for detailed information!

This is a limited-time event—step into the Colosseum and claim your glory! 💥

notes.title: 💥 Synergy Season: New Updates – Rankings, Titles, and Safe Enchant!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34040677/e4c7ab2764402869bb33ef352bae489b8354116d.jpg[/img]

Check out the detailed information about the new updates on the Synergy Season server!

[h3][b]🏆Rankings🏆[/b][/h3]
You can now check character rankings by class on [url=https://dk.masanggames.com/DKONLINE_RANK]our official website[/url]!

[olist]
[*] Character Rankings
[list]
[*] [b]Total:[/b] Updated daily at 2:00 AM UTC, allowing you to track ranking trends over time.
[/list]
[*] Guild Rankings
[list]
[*] [b]Total: [/b]Updated daily at 2:00 AM UTC, showing the current overall guild rankings.
[*] [b]Weekly[/b]: Updated every Monday at 2:00 AM UTC, displaying guild rankings based on points accumulated over the week.
[*] [b]Monthly:[/b] Updated on the 1st of every month at 2:00 AM UTC, showing guild rankings based on activities over the past month.
[/list]
[*] What Are Guild Points?
Guild rankings are determined by Guild Points, earned through various activities like:
[list]
[*] ⚔️ Participating in Siege Wars
[*] 🏰 Using guild dungeons
[*] 📜 Completing guild quests
[*] 📈 Gaining guild EXP
[/list]
Check out the rankings on our website and build synergy with your guild! 
🔗[url=https://dk.masanggames.com/DKONLINE_RANK]DK Online Rankings[/url]
[/olist]

[h3][b] 👑Titles👑[/b][/h3]
Season 3: Synergy introduces an exciting new [b]Title[/b] System!

The Title system allows players to showcase their achievements by equipping rare titles earned through specific conditions, such as completing unique content like Achievements.

Learn how to obtain titles, use them, and explore their features in detail on our official wiki! 
🔗[url=http://dk-wiki.masanggames.com/dkwiki/index.php/Title]Title Infomation[/url]



[h3][b]📜Scrolls📜[/b][/h3]
New enhancement scrolls have been added, allowing safe upgrades!
These scrolls prevent weapon destruction upon failure, making them essential for crafting the ultimate gear.

[olist]
[*] Enchant Scroll Details:
[list]
[*] Shiny Weapon Scroll: Safe enchant for weapons from +6 to +9.
[*] Shiny Armor Scroll: Safe enchant for armor from +4 to +6.
[*] Radiant Weapon Scroll: Safe enchant for weapons from +10 to +11.
[*] Radiant Armor Scroll: Safe enchant for armor from +7 to +8.
[/list]
[*] How to Obtain Scrolls
[list]
[*] Weapon Scrolls: Craft through NPC Aurelia.
[*] Armor Scrolls: Craft through NPC Kvulcan.
[/list]
[*]  Notes:
[list]
[*] These scrolls cannot be used on Eos weapons obtained from Achievement rewards.
[*] While enhancement may fail, the item will not be destroyed.
[/list]
[/olist]

Hello Adventurers! 🎃

November has arrived, bringing a refreshing change to the game!
Embrace the cozy vibes of the season and enjoy the adventures that await! 🍬

✨ Don’t miss out on the Halloween event! ✨


[h1]1. Hot time Event (Extended) [/h1]

- Oct 29, 2024 (Tue) after maintenance - Nov 26, 2024 (Tue) before maintenance

[b]Event Details[/b]

[/table]

[table equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [th]Day[/th]
        [th]Weekend[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [th]Time[/th]
        [td]00:00 - 23:59 (UTC)[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [th]Effect[/th]
        [td]ALL - Item Acquisition  X2[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]
*Obtained items from monster hunting are doubled.
*When equipped with the premium buff set, obtained items increase by four times during the event.


[h1]2. Burning Event (Extended) [/h1]

[b]Event Period[/b]
- Oct 29, 2024 (Tue) after maintenance - Nov 26, 2024 (Tue) before maintenance

[b]Event Details[/b]
- Grow with accumulated experience and buffs you can enjoy during the burning event.

- The EXP increase event resets at 04:00 (UTC) every day.
- The EXP increase event overlaps with the Hoem Premium Buff.
- This event is subject to change without prior notice.


[h1]3. Halloween Event[/h1]

[b]Event Period[/b]
- Oct 29, 2024 (Tue) after maintenance - Nov 26, 2024 (Tue) before maintenance

[b]Event Details[/b]
- Special Halloween items are now on sale.

- Event details may be changed without prior notice.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34040677/af92cde00d052a92c0b3ad50fd62d702d99eba42.png[/img]

notes.title: [Announcement] Guild Recruitment Board Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34040677/85ec7f19120182cc31b19c5cf1475087eab1235e.jpg[/img]

We are excited to introduce the new Guild Recruitment Board!

[b]What is the Guild Recruitment Board?[/b]
[list]
[*] A platform where players not affiliated with a guild can browse and apply directly to guilds that are recruiting.
[/list]
[b]Main Features:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Joining a Guild: Players not currently in a guild can access the guild menu to view the list of available guilds.
[list]
[*] Immediate Join: Applicants are accepted into the guild immediately.
[*] After Approval: Guilds need to manually approve applicants before they can join.
[/list]
[*] Promoting Your Guild: Guild leaders and members with promotion privileges can advertise their guild using the promotion tab.

[*] Managing Applications: For the "After Approval" joining method, the guild master or authorized members can view and manage the list of applicants.
[/olist]

For detailed information, please visit our [url=http://dk-wiki.masanggames.com/dkwiki/index.php/Recruitment_Board]wiki[/url].


Join and promote your guild today with the new Guild Recruitment Board!

notes.title: [Announcement] Known issues on Feb 7 , 2024
notes.content:
Dear player,

[h3]We have identified an issue with connection for some users.[/h3]
When starting the game an error message states,
"cannot find 'mswebwrapper.dll'. please, re-install this application."


There are currently two recommended solutions available to resolve this issue:
[olist]
[*] 'Verify integrity of game files 'in Steam DK Online Manage.
Manage> Properties> Installed Files >Verify integrity of game files
[*] Launch Steam as administrator.
[/olist]
By following these steps, users should be able to connect to the game successfully.
If the issue persists, please submit a ticket through the [url=https://www.masanggames.com/SUPPORT_INQUIRY]CS center[/url] for further assistance.

We apologize for the inconvenience caused.
Thank you for understanding.


Sincerely,
DK Online Team

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[h3]There may be a possibility that an external program is blocking or deleting missing files.

Please check background programs and temporarily disable antivirus software or add the game installation folder as an exception before proceeding with game installation and launching.[/h3]

*When equipped with the premium buff set, obtained items increase by four times during event time.


[h1]2. New Transformation Card Sale Event [/h1]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34040677/f6868106a3ac7896c59f89455db4ecad984d3255.jpg[/img]

- Dec 26, 2023(Tue) after maintenance - Jan 9, 2024 (Tue) before maintenance

notes.title: [Announcement] A New Season Achievement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34040677/6beb76d126381a901380a752d02ebd07389cf530.jpg[/img]

Greetings, Dragon Knights

We've significantly enhanced the reward items to allow players to enjoy our game through normal challenge content!
And now, here is guidance regarding the challenges.

[list]
[*] Season Start Date:  Nov29, 2023
[*] Season End Date: To be Announced (about 10month~12month)
[/list]

[h2][b]What is a Season Server?[/b][/h2]

'Season Server' is an easy-growing server that is integrated into the Standard Server after a certain period of service according to the new content update theme.
It can only be accessed through Steam, and you can enjoy content unique to the season server, such as achievements and DLC.

[h2][b]What is the Achievement?[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Achievement is a system where you can enjoy various contents of DK Online and achieve goals to obtain valuable rewards.
[*] The challenges you can perform increase depending on the character's level.
[*] Challenges can only be performed on Steam season server.
[/list]


[h2][b]Season Achievement Rewards[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Achievement rewards are divided into normal rewards and premium rewards.
[*] Some reward items only allow you to choose one based on your class or purpose. (e.g.Eos Potion of Bravery/ Miracle Cure of Wind/ Magic Magic Power [20ea], Longsword/Greatsword/Staff/Bow of Extinction, Season Premium Package (1Day)/ Dragon's Stick (1Day)/Premium Point 500p, Card: Blue Valkyrie/Premium Point 500p, etc.)
[/list]


[h3][b]Normal Achievement[/b] [/h3]
- Below is information about rewards depending on the required points and subjects.
- You can check the detailed achievement requirements in-game.
- Can be redeemed rewards in order.
- Lv 1 contents are considered Normal Achievement (excluding the "2024 Season Conqueror").
- Normal Achievements are not account-shared, allowing each character to accumulate achievements separately (excluding the "2024 Season Conqueror").

notes.title: Patch Notes - Nov 29, 2023
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34040677/8478d260baa5189c4ccedce1342dcb279b82308a.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!

We are here to announce the updated contents on Nov 29 server maintenance.
Maintenance Period: Nov 28-29, 2023 @15:00 - 00:00(PST)

Season 2 marks a shift away from Pay2Win dynamics. 
You can now conquer new achievements to earn numerous freebies, providing you with a complete gaming experience. It’s a revolution where skill and dedication are finally the keys to triumph!

And there's much more we've prepared. For detailed information, please check out the following section.


[b][h3][Contents][/h3][/b]

[b]1. Season Open Event[/b]
[list]
[*] Add Hot Time Events
[*] Add In-Game Attendance Check Event
[/list]

[b]2. Update[/b]
[list]
[*] Unavailable Christmas Candy, Christmas Chocolate, Christmas Milk, Christmas Cake, Christmas Assorted Gift Box
[*] Unavailable Premium Achievement Reward Reset Ticket (DK Shop)
[*] Add whips in premium stores.
[*] The novelty store sells highly efficient potions.
[*] The balance of the Highlander Cocoon Orc area is modified.
-Highlander Cocoon Orc up (HP, offensive, defensive, experience increased).
[*] Some drop items and probabilities are modified.
- Improve the placement of monsters in the Execution Ground of Lakshtoom.
[*] The contents of the raid-class boss reward box will be reorganized.
[*] Changing the components and probabilities of the boss reward box.
 - Balrog / King of Wind Elemental / King of Water Elemental / King of Earth Elemental / King of Fire Elemental
[*] Scroll of the Dead
 - Adjust the price of weapon/armor scroll of the dead
[*] The maximum level limit is increased to 77 levels.
[*] Add Enhancement: Weapons of a certain grade can now be reinforced up to +15.
[*] Adjust all bosses' respawn time to 30 minutes.
[/list]

[b]3. DLC/ DK Shop[/b]
[list]
[*] Sell Sealed Experience Potions 100% on DK shop
[*] Add 2024 Season DLC (Ultimate Pack)
[*] Apply new buff (double item Item acquisition, premium point acquisition) when utilizing Premium Home Buff, DK Noblesse, and Dionne's Blessing simultaneously.
[/list]

[b]4. Skill Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] Warrior
- Duration increase for Heroic Spirit (Level 1: 1 minute, Level 2: 1 minute 30 seconds)
-Cooldown reduction for Battle Stance to 17 seconds, consumes 35HP instead of 15MP
- Cooldown reduction for Armor Break to 8 seconds, consumes 25HP instead of 15MP
[*] Warlock
- Dark skill resource consumption changed to 50MP and 3 Dark Magic Stones
- Dark skill duration changed to 5 seconds, changed to area-of-effect skill
- Dark skill now applies additional ongoing damage to targets under the dark status effect
[*] Paladin
- Holy Recovery applies to (Self, Nearby Party Members -> Self, Nearby Party Members, Guild Members)
- Tooltip modification for Holy Recovery
- Cooldown reduction for Avatar to 15 seconds
- Cooldown reduction for Provocation to 5 seconds
- Overwhelm resource consumption changed to 30MP and 1 Crystal
-Overwhelm skill applies to (Single Target -> Self, Nearby Party Members)
-Overwhelm skill cannot be canceled by dispelling
[*] Archer
-Cooldown for Elemental Defense (Fire, Water, Earth, Wind) skills changed to 20 seconds
-Mirror Magic skill has been changed to a targeted skill
[/list]

[b]5. Season Achievement [/b]
[list]
[*] Change the way you receive the achievement rewards
[*] Add Sub-tasks to the Monster Conquer 1 achievements
[*] Add Monster Conquer Achievements 2
[*] Add The 2024 season conqueror achievements 
[*] Reorganize free achievement rewards
[*] Add cards to S Rank transformation card box and SS Rank transformation card box.
[/list]

[b]6. New Contents[/b]
[list]
[*] Add Blessed Goddess Grace, Burned-out Grace of Goddess items
[*] Add Blessed Bena Equipment Craft Formula
[*] Add Magic Cubes 
[*] Add a Lazio Silver Exchanger.
[*] Various items can be exchanged for Lazio silver.
[/list]


[i]※ Please note that the contents are subject to change without notice. [/i]
 
Best regards,
DKO Team

notes.title: Update of the Teleport Bracelet
notes.content:
Hello warriors!

Our DK teleport bracelet is updated!
Please check the detailed changes to the bracelet.


[h3]Update of the teleport bracelet[/h3]

Previously teleport bracelet had to be worn, a system moved to a designated location when using a teleport scroll.

Due to wearing equipment (bracelets), it was necessary to change items during hunting/moving frequently.
There were also cases of hunting without changing the bracelet.


That's why our development team has updated Teleport Bracelet.



[h3]What is Teleport Stone?[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34040677/16366a77c631dd9932d480d1877f49631bab7a3c.png[/img]

A teleport stone moves you to a memorized or designated location, and a teleport scroll is required when moving.




[h3]How to get it?[/h3]

DK Shop - You can purchase the item in the convenience category.

[u]※ Users who already have a [b]teleport bracelet[/b] can use it right away without additional purchase.
          (Equipment wearing status will be all unlocked status.)[/u]

[h3]How to use[/h3]
Use the 'Sealed Teleport Stone' in your inventory, the teleport stone is changed to unseal. And then, click the teleport stone, you can teleport to the 'designated place'. However, A teleport scroll is required.




[h3]Usage precautions[/h3]

 The conditions for using the teleport scroll using the memory UI have been changed depending on whether you have a teleport stone or not.

notes.title: [Announcement] The First Season: Achievement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34040677/4efe1cf98410ad87c61ae4882229e25c5b4a9075.png[/img]

Greetings, Dark Knights

Thanks for enjoying our game.
We would like to inform you about the season server.

[list]
[*] Season Start Date: December 20, 2022
[*] Season End Date: To be Announced
[/list]

[h2][b]What is a Season Server?[/b][/h2]

'Season Server' is an easy-growing server that is integrated into the Standard Server after a certain period of service according to the new content update theme.
It can only be accessed through Steam, and you can enjoy content unique to the season server, such as achievements and DLC.

[h2][b]What is the Achievement?[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Achievement is a system where you can enjoy various contents of DK Online and achieve goals to obtain valuable rewards.
[*] The challenges you can perform increase depending on the character's level.
[*] Challenges can only be performed on Steam season server.
[/list]


[h2][b]Season Achievement Rewards[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Achievement rewards are divided into normal rewards and premium rewards.
[*] Some reward items only allow you to choose one based on your class or purpose. (e.g.Eos Potion of Bravery/ Miracle Cure of Wind/ Magic Magic Power [20ea], Longsword/Greatsword/Staff/Bow of Extinction, etc.)
[/list]

notes.title: [Event] The First Season Open Event
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34040677/ec28af5413e330979c478e394f9bfb7fe8529de0.jpg[/img]


[h1]1. Season Burning Event [/h1]

[b]Event Period[/b]
- Dec 20, 2022(Tue) after maintenance - Jan 17, 2023 (Tue) before maintenance

[b]Event Details[/b]
- Grow with accumulated experience and buffs that you can enjoy during the season burning event.

[table]
    [tr]
        [th]Accumulated Time[/th]
        [th]EXP[/th]
        [th]Buff[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td] 1Hour [/td]
        [td]EXP + 5% [/td]
        [td]Defense + 1 [/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td] 2Hours [/td]
        [td]EXP + 10% [/td]
        [td]Defense +1, HP/MP Regeneration +2[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td] 3Hours [/td]
        [td]EXP + 15% [/td]
        [td]All Stats +1, Defense +1, HP/MP Regeneration +2[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

[b]Notes[/b]
- During the event period, experience buffs are applied every connection time.
- The EXP increase event resets at 19:00 (UTC) every day.
- The EXP increase event overlaps with the Hoem Premium Buff.
- This event is subject to change without prior notice.


[h1]2. In-Game Attendance Check Event[/h1]
[b]Event Period[/b]
- Dec 20, 2022(Tue) after maintenance - Jan 17, 2023 (Tue) before maintenance

[b]Event Details[/b]
- For the Season open, we have prepared various items that promote character growth.
Let’s get all of the reward items from 1st day to the last one!

[b]How to Participate [/b]
  1) Launch DK Online
  2) Access the character which you want to receive the rewards
  3) Click the Attendance icon at the bottom of the window
  4) Receive the rewards

*You can receive it once per account



[h1]3. Christmas Event[/h1]

[b]Event Period[/b]
- Dec 20, 2022(Tue) after maintenance - Jan 17, 2023 (Tue) before maintenance

[b]Event Details[/b]
- NPC Landiboy sells 6 types of Christmas buff items at a discount.

[table]
    [tr]
        [th]Item Name[/th]
        [th]Effect[/th]
        [th]Price (Florin)[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td] Christmas Milk [/td]
        [td]HP Regeneration +8, MP Regeneration +4[/td]
        [td]400[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td] Christmas Candy [/td]
        [td]All Attacks  +1[/td]
        [td]600[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td] Christmas Chocolate [/td]
        [td]Defense +3[/td]
        [td]600[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Christmas Cake [/td]
        [td]Accuracy+3, All Attacks  +2 [/td]
        [td]800[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Christmas Assorted Gift Box [/td]
        [td]Use Socks, Milk, Candy, Chocolate, and Cake at the same time for 30 minutes.[/td]
        [td]2,600[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

notes.title: [Maintenance] Scheduled Maintenance on Dec 20, 2022 (Completed)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34040677/6c401e21e8fb6055044eb64f0256182539763136.png[/img]
Greetings!

We will be performing scheduled maintenance on Monday.
During this period, DK Online will be unavailable.

 

[b]Duration: 7 hours[/b]

[list]
[*] 17:00 - 00:00 (PST, 12/19 -12/20, 2022)
[*] 01:00 - 08:00 (UTC, 12/20, 2022)
[/list] 


[b]Changes:[/b]

[b]<Global Servers>[/b]
Redisse Server -> Standard Server

1. Add Open Event

2. Increased level limit 52 > 65
PvP level limit 26 > 51

3. Skill acquisition limit level increase
Maximum acquisition level: Combat 50 / Magic 48 > Combat / Magic 64

4. Changes to Novelty Store items
[list]
[*] Sales: Grace of Dione, Balt Weapon/Armor Magic Scroll, Finest Buff Potion, Return Scroll to Castle
[*] Removed: Weapon/Armor Magic Scroll
[/list]
5. In-app store (DK Shop) sales list change
[list]
[*] Sales:  Home Premium (30 Days), [Season Server] Premium Achievement Reward Reset Ticket, Enchant Stone (1ea, 5ea, 10ea)
Character transformation card box (Obtain one of the following:  S/SS Rank Transform Card Box 1, S/SS Rank Transform Card Box 2, Unique Soul Transform Card Box)
Monster transformation card box (Obtain one of the following: Common/Uncommon Monster/Rare / Epic/Boss Monster Transform Card Box)
Sealed Eos Dragon’s Stick (30 Days)
[*]Removed:
Transformation Scroll (Ador, Sparrow, Lukard, Aish, Pinaell, Lukia, Valkyrie, Kaidel, Immortal Kaidel, Eirin, Leia, Lilith, Lukard of Assassination, Charming Aisha, Scarlet Lukia, Eirin of the Spirit)
[/list]
6. Add Ladyboy
Sales: Bena's equipment (T-shirt, bracelet, belt), Monster transformation card box, Christmas buff food

7. Premium Shop Change
[list]
[*] Sales: 3 types of Buff Scrolls (Warlock, Sorceress, Archer/Paladin), 5 kinds of Killing Magical Catalyst (Beast, Human, Demon, Undead, Elemental)
[*] Removed:  Transformation Scroll, Token of Guardian, Belt of Harmony (unlimited)
[/list]
8. Add transformation
[list]
[*] Yoyo/Alchemist Yoyo
[*] West Wind Pixie/Ardor Rakuroon
[*] Benedict/Judgment Benedict
[*] Bella/Avarice Bella
[*] Elin/Elin of Gale
[/list]
9. Add Guild Contents
[list]
[*] Siege
[*] Guild Dungeon
[/list]
10. Add hunting ground
[list]
[*] Swamp of Grief 
[*] Elemental Tower (Water, Wind, Fire, Earth all floors)
[*] Lumen Tower (1~3F)
[*] Lakshtoom (Mines, The Lost City, Prison of Ambition/Corruption/Pleasure/Rage/Penitence/Revival)
[/list]
11. Removed Content
[list]
[*] Magic Cube
[*] 1:1 Trade
[*] Private Store
[/list]
*The Siege war starts next week.

12. Others
- Change Premium buff
- Cash Inventory account attribution
- Add the upper/lower price limit system when selling an item on Consignment Store.

[b]<Season Server>[/b]
1. Add Steam season server-exclusive content
- Add Achievement
- Add DLC on Steam

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
The maintenance has been completed at 00:00 PDT / 08:00 UTC. 
Thank you for your patience.
 

I appreciate your patience.
 
[i]*Please note that the estimated length of time for maintenance is subject to change. We will update you if there are any changes.[/i]



Best Regards,
DK Online Team

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes - 1st April 2019
notes.content:
Please check the detailed patch notes below.


[Event]
- [Guild Event] 4th-week reward is given.
- [Server Ranking Event] reward is given.
- Close Guild Grow-up Event.
- Close Server Ranking Event.
- Close Launching Special Package Sale Event.


[Cash shop]
-Scroll: Lukard, Scroll: Aisha are added.
-Card: Ador, Card: Sparrow, Card: Pinaell are added.
 * If you buy a Transformation card, you can register that Transformation card.
 * You can transform through registered card by using various transformation items. 
 * Each card has a colored soul. you can obtain the registered card’s soul.
 * The soul can enhance your character: http://wiki.dk.masanggames.com/dkwiki/index.php/Soul_System
 * You can obtain the SS-Rank transformation card or S-Rank transformation card by combining S-Rank transformation cards.
-Eos Dragon’s Stick 1D / 7D are added.
-Eos Blessed Transformation Scroll is added.


[Novelty Merchant]
- The cost of Low Grade Magical Catalyst 10ea is changed into 15 Florins.
- Arrange of the item is changed.


[PremiumMerchant]
-Eos Blessed Magical Catalyst 1000ea is added.
-Eos Scroll: Lukard, Eos Scroll: Aisha, Eos Scroll: Lukard of Assassination, Eos Scroll: Charming Aisha are added.


[Wind Elemental Tower]
- Wind Elemental Tower 1F~3F are open: http://wiki.dk.masanggames.com/dkwiki/index.php/Wind_Elemental_Tower_Monsters_Information
- 'Entrance of Wind Elemental Tower' is added in teleport bracelet (Field).
 * You have to pay the fee and reach level 30 to enter the Wind Elemental Tower.
 * The level limit of  Wind Elemental Tower 2F is level 30  and 3F is level 40.
 * In Wind Elemental Tower 1F, there are NPCs who support you instead of monsters.
 * You can obtain the Wind Attribute Resistance Buff by giving some florins to NPC Sylpid. 
- The Wind Elemental Tower 2F ~ 3F are added in Hunting Guide.
- Can search the new items which appear in the Wind Elemental Tower via Item Dictionary.


[Chat]
- Prohibited words are added.
-’World chat’ level limit is changed into 30.
[b]*If you are a newbie, please use 'Class' Chat.[/b]


[Attribute Enchant]
- The attribute is systems that provide additional performance in terms of attack and defense. There are Attribute attack and Attribute resistance, which can give the monster more damage and minimize the damage received.
- The Gemstone with Wind Attribute can be changed into Wind Attribute Stone through NPC Theo.
- You can strengthen the attributes of weapons by using Wind Attribute Stone.
- Attribute enchanted weapon can attack weakness attribute monster with additional damage. 
- For more detailed information, please visit the WIKI page: http://wiki.dk.masanggames.com/dkwiki/index.php/Attribute_Enchant

notes.title: [Updated] Patch Notes - March 5th 2019
notes.content:
Please check the detailed patch notes below.


1. Transformation

Transformation system is added.

 The character’s appearance is changed through the transformation. You can receive different options depending on transformation monsters.

 Check the detailed information about the transformation below.

[url=http://wiki.dk.masanggames.com/dkwiki/index.php/Transformation][Wiki Link (Transformation)][/url]

2. Monster HP Bar

 Monster HP bar is added.
 Now you can check the decrease of monster’s HP via a red bar of target UI. 




3. Item Dictionary

 Item Dictionary system is added.
 If you search the item name, you can check that item’s enchantment information and craft materials information. 




4. Smart Hunting Guide

 You can check the recommended hunting ground. hunting ground is recommended depending on the character’s defense and field name’s color is also changed depending on difficulty.

Easy: Blue
Normal: White
Difficult: Red

 When you click the field in the hunting guide window, you can see the obtainable core equipment and material items. 
(*Character’s location is not displayed via hunting guide.)




5. Merchant Sales Items are added.

The sales items are added on the sales list of Weapons Dealer in metropolis.
The sales items are added on the sales list of Armor Dealer in metropolis.
Added Skill books (up to Lv48) to item list of Skill Book Merchants in metropolis.





Thanks!
DK Online Team

notes.title: Early Access Frequently Asked Questions
notes.content:
Hello, players!

We heard your questions and feedback.
Here are the Frequently Asked Questions.


[h1]Q. When trying to choose a character and start to play, the game crashed.[/h1]
A. Before the game starts, please turn off anti-softwares (Trend Micro, Avast) and start the game. If we can't solve this problem, we will let you know how to set the exception list in your anti-software later.

[h1]Q. Is there going to wipe character record or not?[/h1]
A. It will be a character wipe after Early Access. 

[h1]
Q. Why is Early Access service too short?[/h1]
A. This is kind of beta service for checking game balance and bugs.
By getting feedback quickly, we can focus on improving bugs and including more interesting contents on the official launch. 
We really sorry our early access is too short.

[h1]Q. Is there going to be Europe server?[/h1]
A. Only global service(English) is available. Europe services are not planned yet.

[h1]
Q. Where is monster HP bar?[/h1]
A. Actually, our game doesn't have monster HP bar.
However, After reviewing the feedback from players, we decided to put the monster HP bar. 
We will make it available when the service is officially open.
Thank you for you guys feedback.

[h1]Q. Where are guide and information for drop items and monsters?[/h1]
A. We are preparing the official Wiki, forum, and website now. 
When official service opens, you can see detailed information what you want.

[h1]Q. Can’t log in because of restricted account error.[/h1]
A. It is a kind of bug. We have confirmed that the message will be displayed at login after the application terminated abnormally.
After exiting the game completely, you can log in without the problem.
We apologize for the inconvenience caused.

[h1]Q. How to reset the second password when I forget it?[/h1]
A. We are very sorry that we can’t solve this in EA period because of the system problem ... =< 
This problem will not happen in official release. Sorry once again.


We will provide a lot of information about updates and solved bugs for official release through this steam announcement. 
As always, thank you for being part of the DK Online community.ːsteamhappyː



Sincerely,
DK Online Team
